results.title: Senior Software Engineer
results.description:
Entropik is an AI-powered consumer research platform. Led backend architecture for the Decode product suite.
• Led design and development of multiple backend product features using FastAPI, focusing on scalable architecture, performance optimization, and maintainability across 50+ microservices.
• Defined service boundaries and API contracts, enabling parallel frontend-backend development and reducing integration time.
• Engineered an AI-assisted moderated interview pipeline that auto-generates research insights, significantly reducing cost and eliminating manual moderation overhead.
• Collaborated closely with ML engineers, data engineers, and data scientists to productionize AI/ML models, optimize inference pipelines, and improve overall system performance.
• Improved production observability using structured logging and monitoring tools, measurably reducing incident resolution time.
• Owned system reliability and operational excellence across distributed services, including performance tuning, observability, and incident management.
• Collaborated directly with product stakeholders to gather requirements, refine feature scope, and align deliverables with business goals.
• Explored and integrated emerging AI/ML tools and technologies to deliver innovative backend solutions that addressed evolving business needs.
• Diagnosed and resolved critical production bugs under tight timelines, minimising downtime and ensuring service reliability.

results.title: Software Engineer
results.description:
AppViewX is a global leader in certificate lifecycle management and network automation. Worked with enterprise clients across US, UK, and Singapore.
• Designed and delivered 100+ Python-based automation workflows for Certificate Lifecycle Management covering discovery, creation, renewal, revocation, and expiry notifications – reducing manual intervention significantly.
• Built a Django-powered CLM system that streamlined certificate operations and boosted team productivity by 67%.
• Developed and containerized Flask-based microservice APIs to automate F5 LTM object provisioning (virtual servers, pools, nodes, monitors), improving deployment speed and reducing errors.
• Leveraged FastAPI to design and deploy secure, high-performance asynchronous APIs for production environments.
• Integrated cross-platform notification workflows across ServiceNow, JIRA, Slack, MS Teams, PagerDuty, and BMC Remedy, simplifying PKI and infrastructure monitoring.
• Built and fine-tuned an AI-powered chatbot using NLP and Named Entity Recognition (NER), improving user query resolution and end-user experience.
• Developed an internal AppViewX SDK that reduced API call failures and improved overall deployment stability.
• Collaborated with Product Owners on requirement gathering, effort estimation, and functional specs; coordinated cross-functional teams to deliver high-priority features on time.
• Proficient in AWS (S3, EC2, Lambda) for scalable deployment and serverless application management; experienced with SQL and MongoDB query optimization.
